gtk4

gtk4 Components
  • Flow
  • Image --- Images --- An image is gtk4rt's rather than a GIR class: a box holding the source it shows, fitted as `fit` says, or the placeholder where it holds none.
  • ImageDrawing
  • ImageUrl
  • Scroll A scroll is gtk4rt's GtkScrolledWindow, which moves along `direction` and reports the end of its content coming within half a viewport of showing -- as it arrives, and when the content changes size while it is there.
  • Span One run of words.
  • Toplevel A toplevel: the host object a `ui.window` is on this platform.
  • draw
  • drawSource The primitive a `canvasImage` paints its source through.
  • platform The `gtk4` node of a build directive: `output { go { gtk4() } }`.
    • Types
  • CairoContext --- Drawing --- A canvas here is a GtkDrawingArea and its draw callback is handed a `cairo_t*`, so cairo's own functions are the drawing vocabulary.
  • DrawEvent What a `@draw` handler is handed: the context, and the coordinate space the shapes were placed in.
  • FontSlant The slant and the weight are typedef'd enums like the line cap and join, so they are cast the same way rather than passed as `C.int` -- cgo refuses an int where a `cairo_font_slant_t` belongs.
  • FontWeight
  • LineCapValue cairo's cap and join are typedef'd enums, not plain ints, so the declarations name those types and a conversion is written where the value is produced.
  • LineJoinValue
  • Picture The picture a URL names, decoded once: a file the program carries at once, one fetched when it arrives.
  • Schedule The armed source itself, held as an opaque type rather than as an id paired with its callback slot in a table the runtime keeps.
  • SourceEvent What a `drawSource` paints a carried or fetched image with: the context, the URL its source names and the picture the source holds.
    • Functions
  • arcTo The corner is solved by `sngl:ui/draw`, which two targets need and neither host has: cairo takes a center and two angles where the command gives three points and a radius.
  • bordered Whether a Style says anything of its border, which then is all of it.
  • boxLookBesideVisible lookBesideVisible for a GtkBox.
  • boxLookOf The look of a GtkBox, which holds its spacing: its gap, or what the override spaces its children by.
  • calendarDate The day a calendar has selected.
  • checkActive What a control holds, read off its widget.
  • clipOf
  • crossOf An unset alignment is CSS's default, stretch.
  • cssColor
  • cssOf
  • decl
  • dropDownLabel The label a drop-down has selected, or "" where it has none.
  • entryText
  • every
  • innerFrameLookOf The look of the frame a clickable card's button holds: the button draws the card's border, so the frame draws the theme's only where the Style says nothing of one.
  • inset GTK takes no negative length, which CSS allows for a margin; an unset one is none.
  • justifyOf
  • length A length as CSS text, nothing where the Style leaves it unset.
  • lineCap cairo takes its line cap and join as enum values.
  • lineJoin
  • lineOf A border its Style gives a width and no line is drawn solid, as every target without CSS's default of none draws one.
  • loadPicture
  • lookBesideVisible The look of a widget whose visibility a prop drives, which answers `display` itself through shown.
  • lookHidden
  • lookOf What GTK takes for a Style: CSS for the widget's own node, and beside it what GTK says through properties instead.
  • offerChoices Offers a drop-down the labels `labels` joins with newlines, and selects `chosen` where one of them is it and nothing where none is.
  • paint Fill then stroke the current path, preserving it between the two when both apply.
  • paintPicture Paints a picture into a box, scaled once per box size rather than per frame; one still on its way paints nothing, and is there the next time the drawing paints after it arrives.
  • px A length in pixels, as codegen.MeasurementPx reads one for this target: an em is 16 of them, as html, android and bubbletea read one.
  • refPicture
  • selectDay GtkCalendar takes the day, month and year as three separate ints -- its own `date` property is a GLib.DateTime, which no SNGL expression produces -- and a `date` offers no way to take those three apart.
  • setEntryText Writes an entry's text, which an override does itself rather than binding `text`: see ui.input.
  • shown
  • side One side of a margin or a padding: the first of its own field, its axis's and the whole box's that is set, as CSS reads them.
  • slantOf
  • source cairo wants each channel as 0..1 where SNGL carries 0..255.
  • spacingOf A box's spacing: its gap, or what the override spaces its children by.
  • switchActive
  • textAlignOf
  • toFontSlant
  • toFontWeight
  • toLineCap
  • toLineJoin
  • unrefPicture
  • weightOf
  • wrapOf
    • Constants
  • unstyled What a Style may say that GTK does not answer: - maxWidth, maxHeight: GTK gives a widget at least its minimum and as much as its parent allocates, and nothing caps it.
